titulo: El día que el *portero* subió a rematar en el último minuto
estilo: Japanese sports anime film still, cel shading, clean bold line art, dramatic night stadium floodlights, volumetric light beams, lens flare, painterly packed crowd, high contrast cinematic color grade, 16:9 widescreen. No text, no letters, no numbers on scoreboards, no logos, no club crests, no sponsor marks, no watermark.
